hints.title: Ordered Elements Scan
hints.text: Sorting the numbers ascending allows evaluating pairs from opposite ends systematically.

hints.title: Boundary Convergence
hints.text: Place one index at the smallest element and the second at the largest element, adjusting based on whether the sum meets the bound.

hints.title: Track Maximum Under Bound
hints.text: If the pair sum is strictly less than k, record it as a candidate maximum and increment the lower index; otherwise decrement the upper index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting the array in O(N log N) time enables linear boundary convergence with zero extra storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly implement the sorted boundary convergence and return -1 when no valid pair exists.
complexity.notes: Requires strictly less than k, not less than or equal to k.
